frozen_decision_rule.B_F: Per run, Q(ETOT)+B_TS+gamma_3*(|ETOT|+|TS|+|lambda*Tr(WP)|)+B_lambda_trace; spectral external term is zero. Let B_trace=gamma_256*sum|W_ij P_ji|+sum|W_ij|*P_component_bound_ji; B_lambda_trace=|lambda|*B_trace+Q_lambda*(|Tr(WP)|+B_trace). Qcomplex(P) is the captured P reconstruction input bound.
frozen_decision_rule.B_TS: Independently reconstruct S directly from captured occupation and k-weight tokens. Require a one-to-one (global k, global band) join with no duplicates/gaps/missing rows, and require exact equality to expected_n_kpoints and expected_band_indices bound from the run metadata and source capture loop. source/self.f90 writes every eigenvalues(ib,ik) row; k indices are exactly 0..N_k-1 because the writer stores ig-1, and band_index=ib-1 is the zero-based global spin-inclusive eigenvalue row, as verified by that loop and the complete scalar-collinear eigensystem; no additional spin factor is applied. Require same per-k weights across bands. The capture writer and fermi_dirac_entropy call the same fermi_dirac_occupation kernel on the same eigenvalue/EF/effective-kT table; bind those raw eigenvalue/EF/kT rows as a consistency check. Use source kB_Ry_per_K=6.3336814e-6 (exact binary64 source constant) and TS=T_K*kB*S. Treat every printed occupation, weight and temperature K token as a closed interval with its token-derived Q; propagate through h(f) with outward interval arithmetic, using h(0)=h(1)=0 and h(f)<=ln(2). Use Decimal ln at 100 and 160 digits with a checked precision enclosure. B_TS is Q(TS token)+abs(TS token-HP center)+the propagated interval radius plus the checked Decimal enclosure. The center discrepancy captures production entropy/log/summation behavior; no unsupported libm gamma bound is assumed.

frozen_decision_rule.h2_resolution: Approved h2-dominance rule: A=D(.005)-D(.0025), B=D(.01)-D(.005), L=(16A-B)/36, H=(B-4A)/180. Propagate uA/uB from frozen uD and arithmetic bounds, then uL/uH through these linear combinations. Require |L|>uL and |L|-uL>16*(|H|+uH), evaluated with outward uncertainty and exact Decimal comparison. This replaces only the former strict 4:1 scaling check. Keep Richardson, g0/ug0, N_unc and |R_fine-g0|<=N_unc unchanged.
frozen_decision_rule.identity_bias: B_W=R_fine-g0; report independently and pass only if scaling is resolved and abs(B_W)<=N_unc.
frozen_decision_rule.noncircular_allowance: N_unc=uR_fine+B_trunc+ug0, rounded upward with a gamma bound for its addition. The measured identity residual is excluded from N_unc.
frozen_decision_rule.repeat_uncertainty: uR_fine=(4uD_0.0025+uD_0.005)/3; uR_coarse=(4uD_0.005+uD_0.01)/3, each rounded upward and augmented by gamma bounds for Richardson arithmetic.
frozen_decision_rule.serialized_Q: For each captured E/e24.16 or ES24.16 token, preserve the raw token and derive Q as half its decimal quantum from the token's actual mantissa digits and emitted exponent, including printed zero tokens. The lambda-input uncertainty is half-ULP of its exact deck/runtime binary value.
frozen_decision_rule.truncation_bound: B_trunc=abs(R_fine-R_coarse)/15 + (uR_fine+uR_coarse)/15, rounded upward with a gamma bound for its arithmetic.
frozen_decision_rule.uF_ry: abs(F_tight(lambda)-F_standard(lambda)) + B_F_tight + B_F_standard + gamma_1*(|F_tight|+|F_standard|), rounded upward with propagated analysis arithmetic bounds. No fixed absolute energy comparator is added.
frozen_decision_rule.ug0: abs(Tr(W1*(P_tight(0)-P_standard(0)))) + gamma_256*sum_ij abs(W1_ij)*(|P_standard(0)_ji|+|P_tight(0)_ji|) + sum_ij abs(W1_ij)*(P_component_bound_standard_ji+P_component_bound_tight_ji); dynamic scales and input bounds use both matrices, separately per mode.
